Each component is established but their correct integration, handling of crystallographic directions, and fitting to extract core energies require careful implementation and domain knowledge, placing it at level 3.

This multi-stage workflow with dependencies (MD relaxation, post-processing) is a moderate orchestration typical of a small computational study, fitting level 3.
